description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the BasicWorkSchedule service in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It tests methods related to retrieving work shift start/end times and shift length for an employee, including scenarios where employee-specific data is absent and defaults are used.

classes.name: BasicWorkScheduleTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for BasicWorkSchedule, testing retrieval of work shift times and length, with mocked dependencies.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftStartEndTime
methods.description: Tests that getWorkShiftStartEndTime() returns the correct start and end times from the employee’s work shift.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftStartEndTimeEmployeeWorkShiftEmpty
methods.description: Tests fallback to default work shift times when employee’s work shift data is unavailable.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftLength
methods.description: Tests that getWorkShiftLength() correctly calculates and returns the shift duration.
